Medium Affected: WATER
Suspected Responsible Party: LAFARGE BUILDING MATERIALS
SkyTruth Analysis
Lat/Long: 42.493300, -73.856896 (Approximated from ZIP)
Report Description
****WEB REPORT**** AN ABANDONED #6 OIL PIPE DEVELOPED A MINOR LEAK. THE PIPE TRAVELS A SMALL DISTANCE OVER OPEN WATER. THE ABANDONED PIPE IS ABOVE GROUND AND IN THE HOT SUN, CAUSING THE OIL REMAINING IN THE LINE TO BE MORE FLUID. A SMALL AMOUNT OF OIL DRIPPED INTO THE EDGE OF THE HUDSON RIVER. THE AMOUNT IS BELIEVED TO BE A FEW OUNCES. THE LEAK APPEARS TO BE FROM A SMALL FITTING ON THE BOTTOM OF THE PIPE. ANY OIL THAT MAY CONTINUE TO DRIP IS NOW (AS OF 1400) BEING CAPTURED IN A BUCKET. A CONTRACTOR IS CURRENTLY ASSESSING THE PIPE AND WILL MAKE REPAIRS AS SOON AS POSSIBLE. THE NYSDEC HAS BEEN NOTIFIED (SPILL # 1203156)
